add.issue.name: Sonar discovery and opt-in side shelves

edit.description.md: Add an opt-in cursor-origin Sonar reveal with shell and plugin targets, disabled-feature discovery, and per-output side docks and tabs. Preserve the released Signal appearance and keep hidden windows unmounted. Shelves stay open until click-away or their shortcut. Extend the versioned plugin contract and document controls. One combined feature PR authorized for this work; no automatic merge.
